Style: retro cartoon graffiti poster with a 1990s underground EDM party aesthetic. The composition is a single vertical event-poster design dominated by a deep green background, hot pink line-art doodles, and distressed white typography. Across the upper area, loose graffiti marks, lightning bolts, stars, splatters, and music-note icons create a playful electronic-party atmosphere around the central title. The main headline sits near the top center in oversized bold white block lettering reading "TALIEU& FRIENDS", with rough speckled texture, black shadowing, and an uneven hand-painted street-art feel. Beneath it, a smaller but still prominent white subtitle reads "DJ PARTY", framed by short decorative strokes and underlined with energetic brush marks.

In the middle section, the date and time are centered inside a dark green rectangular label outlined in hot pink, with the text reading "2025年9月20日，下午1点至晚上10点". Below that, a compact lineup panel uses stacked white uppercase lettering on the same green field, listing "阿奇·布里安特" as the featured performer. Further down, the venue information appears in clear white Chinese text reading "伦敦E1区砖巷150号东93英尺，邮编E16QL". The central illustration shows two cartoon crocodiles acting as DJs behind a large DJ console, drawn with thick black outlines, bright green bodies, white teeth, expressive eyes, and exaggerated friendly expressions. One crocodile wears a backward cap and headphones while leaning toward the mixer; the other wears a backward cap and sunglasses while gripping a turntable or controller. The DJ equipment spans the lower middle of the poster, with turntables, knobs, sliders, buttons, waveform displays, and glowing cyan-green screen details rendered in a comic-graffiti style. Around the crocodiles, hot pink musical notes, sketchy equalizer bars, splashes, scribbles, arrows, and abstract graffiti shapes reinforce the music theme without obscuring the main information.

The overall layout keeps the hierarchy clear: title first, then subtitle, then date, lineup, and venue details. The palette stays tightly controlled around dark green, hot pink, white, black outlines, and small cyan highlights on the equipment screens. The poster feels humorous, energetic, and nostalgic, combining cartoon animal comedy with gritty electronic-music flyer energy. All text elements use bold white lettering against the green background for strong contrast.

复古卡通涂鸦EDM派对海报，主题为“TALIEU&FRIENDS”。该设计以绿色、粉色和白色为主色调，呈现出一种充满趣味的DJ叙
事风格。1.视觉焦点：核心视觉元素是一只卡通绿色的鳄鱼DJ，背景为绿色，并带有粉色线条艺术涂鸦纹理。主场景描绘了两只鳄
鱼正在操作DJ台，点缀着音符，以强调派对的轻松幽默氛围。2.信息元素：细节以清晰的层次结构呈现：标题“TALIEU&
FRIENDS”以粗体白色文字突出显示。它还列出了日期“2025年9月20日，下午1点至晚上10点”、演出阵容（阿奇·布里安特）
以及场地“伦敦E1区砖巷150号东93英尺，邮编E16QL”。3.色彩与纹理：以绿色为底色，粉色涂鸦轮廓和白色字体为主，设计叠
加了卡通人物和DJ元素，重现了90年代地下EDM派对海报的复古、俏皮质感。它完美融合了卡通鳄鱼的幽默感、电子音乐元素的
动感能量，以及对比色带来的视觉张力，既捕捉到了派对的狂欢精神，又体现了复古涂鸦的轻松氛围。
